note: The default operating-rules module. packages/naive/src/terms/operating-rules.ts loads this file and merges a venture's operating-rules.json over it. That file sits at the venture root, or at meta/operating-rules.json when the layout is structured. The membership gate reads rejection.retry. The other settings are declared for later pull requests and are not enforced yet.

rejection.note: A rejected handoff package. edit and rejector are for the later parent-only edits pull request. retry is read by the membership gate.

edit.note: Only the package's parent node, the sender, may edit a rejected package. In this module that role is the Naive Lead, the chief-of-staff role. Not enforced yet.

rejector.note: A function bot that rejects a package cannot modify it. It may only return the package to the parent with the failing gate and the reason. Not enforced yet.

one_way_door.note: A one_way_door package skips the retry and escalates to the founder. Not enforced yet.

retry.note: The Lead retries a rejected package once, then it escalates to the founder. The membership gate copies on_reject, retry_by, retries, then and escalate_to. The one_way_door skip is not enforced yet.

self_fix.note: The Lead's self-fix proposals need founder approval before they are applied. A later pull request enforces this. The membership gate does not read it.

design.note: Every agent runs the gates on its draft before showing the founder a design. A later pull request enforces this. The membership gate does not read it.

diff.note: The design-diff verb set. One kind per diff line. A compound change is split into separate lines. A move that keeps the id counts as rename. A later pull request enforces this.

jev.note: Suggested Noul thresholds: at or above yes is a yes, at or below no is a no. mode record-only writes the judgment and does not block, until the thresholds are decided. A later pull request reads this. The membership gate does not.

questions.note: Question routing, impact tiers, standing rules, SPRT loss, signals, time to detect, suspension, notifications and the Lean requirement. A later pull request implements them. Wilson thresholds and SPRT parameters are provisional, pending Lean proofs. The membership gate does not read this.

type.note: A question type is a verb with its kind, a noun or a scoped noun, and the function that asks.

routing.note: A rule names any non-empty subset of those three parts and routes to a function agent, to the founder, or to a standing answer. The most specific matching rule wins. Equally specific matches go to the founder.

impact.note: A question type's tier is the max of four scores, each 1, 2 or 3: severity, reversibility, time_to_detect, blast_radius. Agents may raise a tier. Only the founder may lower one. Not enforced yet.

standing.note: Provisional, pending Lean: z, low and costly. A standing rule is earned when the Wilson lower bound over the full answer history reaches the tier's threshold. There is no separate minimum number of answers. The lower bound is what requires enough of them. one_way_door never stands. Deletes never stand. The founder approves each rule. A rule pauses when the founder answers differently. Not enforced yet.

loss.note: Provisional, pending Lean: p0, p1, alpha and beta. Each is above 0 and below 1, alpha + beta is below 1, and p0 is below p1. The statistic is floored at 0. A standing rule is lost by SPRT on recent outcomes. Not enforced yet.

signals.note: Override and correction count against the rule. Silence is no data. A frustration flag triggers a confirming question and does not count as a failure. Periodic spot checks sample the rule's answers. A package rejection counts as a failure for the rule that produced it. Not enforced yet.

time_to_detect.note: Each question type has time_to_detect. Outcomes are scored only after it passes. A slow-to-detect type stays costly or higher. Not enforced yet.

suspension.note: A suspended rule restarts from zero after a cooldown. A long-running rule gets periodic reconfirmation. Not enforced yet.

notifications.note: A one_way_door question interrupts immediately. A costly question gets a veto window. A low question goes in a daily digest. Not enforced yet.

lean.note: one_way_door math must be proven in Lean before use, and CI blocks until it is. costly runs record-only until proven. low needs tests, and Lean is optional. Not enforced yet.
